payload.description: Defaults to null when omitted. Each command validates its own payload fields.

project_id.description: Optional active-project scope; mismatches are rejected before dispatch.

expected_catalog_generation.description: Required for definition writes after the first reset. Prevents an editor from publishing into an obsolete catalog.

harness.description: May be empty before native runtime preparation; the concrete installation is frozen in RuntimeBinding.

sandbox.description: May be empty before native runtime preparation; the concrete installation is frozen in RuntimeBinding.

intent.description: Opaque provider intent, preserved as any JSON value; defaults to null.

DeliverySources.description: Immutable direct source Delivery IDs. Live closure requires completed Task implementation deliveries; a merge candidate requires its original source Delivery. Recursive evidence is frozen before review dispatch.

ExecutionRetryCleanup.description: execution.retry_cleanup: target is a stopped and sealed RuntimeExecution with cleanup_failed status; never deletes a shared installation.

MergeCaptureSnapshot.description: merge.capture_snapshot: append an audit snapshot for a completed merge; original snapshots remain immutable.

NativeInputLimits.description: Ordinary conversation input is at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes; a host-created formal Run evidence envelope is at most 524288 bytes. A native execution budget is fifteen minutes, excluding pending human decisions. Errors never switch execution providers implicitly.

ToolDefinition.description: Harness native tool groups and executable HTTP/MCP action definitions.

Origin.description: Human-authored material or externally observed execution evidence.

HarnessPreference.description: Project creation preferences reference exact Model and Harness component revisions. Executions use the selected Agent composition.

NativeToolDefinition.description: Native tools are selected explicitly from the Harness tool group.
